logger.doc:name: Log Ingest Start
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "ok" var msg = "IDP Ingest - START - Scanning document library '" ++ vars.libraryBase ++ "', folder: " ++ (vars.libraryBase ++ '/' ++ p('sharepoint.folder.source')) --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, (payload: {documentLibrary: vars.libraryBase}) if (p('log.level') == "DEBUG"), env: p('mule.env') })]

logger.doc:name: Log Files Found
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var fileCount = sizeOf(payload default []) var fileList = (payload default []) map $.Name var status = "ok" var msg = "IDP Ingest - Files retrieved from SharePoint library '" ++ vars.libraryBase ++ "': " ++ fileCount as String ++ " files" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, (payload: {documentLibrary: vars.libraryBase, fileCount: fileCount, files: fileList}) if (p('log.level') == "DEBUG"), env: p('mule.env') })]

foreach.doc:name: For Each PDF (sequential)
foreach.collection: #[payload default [] filter ((file) -> lower((file.Name default '')) endsWith ('.' ++ p('sharepoint.filter.extension')))]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { executionId: vars.executionId, fileName: vars.fileName, documentLibrary: vars.libraryBase, processingUrl: vars.processingUrl, outputPath: vars.outputPath, processedPath: vars.processedPath, errorPath: vars.errorPath, pollCount: 0 }

logger.doc:name: Log Submitted
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "ok" var msg = "IDP Ingest - File submitted to IDP successfully: " ++ vars.fileName ++ " (library: " ++ vars.libraryBase ++ ")" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, (payload: {documentLibrary: vars.libraryBase, fileName: vars.fileName, executionId: vars.executionId, processingUrl: vars.processingUrl}) if (p('log.level') == "DEBUG"), env: p('mule.env') })]

logger.doc:name: Log Ingest Failure
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "error" var msg = "IDP Ingest - FAILED to process file: " ++ (vars.fileName default 'unknown') ++ " (library: " ++ (vars.libraryBase default 'unknown') ++ ")" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, (payload: {documentLibrary: vars.libraryBase, fileName: vars.fileName, errorType: error.errorType.identifier, errorDescription: error.description}) if (p('log.level') == "DEBUG"), env: p('mule.env') })]

logger.doc:name: Log Move-to-Error Failure
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "warning" var msg = "IDP Ingest - WARNING: Could not move failed file to Error folder: " ++ (vars.fileName default 'unknown') ++ " (library: " ++ (vars.libraryBase default 'unknown') ++ ")" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, env: p('mule.env') })]
